goal: Returning user, mid-way through working on the soft-close habit.

goal.whyNow: wants to stop softening his closes

interventionCycle.intervention: land the final sentence, no softener

expectedCoachMove: Warm, brief re-entry that points at the current thread (the clean close) with one small next step. 1-2 lines. No exclamation, no gushing, no dumping a report, no intake questions.
badAnswerExample: Hello! Welcome back! I'm so excited to help you on your communication journey today! What would you like to work on? Do you want to practice, review your stats, or set a new goal?
excellentAnswerExample: Good to have you back. Stay on the close today — one clean landing, then stop. Ready when you are.
disqualifiers: what would you like to work on
